article.story: AUBURN, Ala. -- — Kevin Overton and Keyshawn Hall each had 21 points in Auburn's 78-67 victory against South Alabama on Tuesday in the NIT. Overton also contributed seven rebounds for the Tigers (18-16). Hall added six rebounds. Kaden Magwood shot 4 of 8 from the field, including 3 for 7 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 3 from the line to finish with 14 points. Chaze Harris led the way for the Jaguars (21-12) with 29 points, eight rebounds and six assists. South Alabama also got 14 points apiece from Stephen Williams and Jayden Cooper. Overton scored 21 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
